title: CrowdGrid - Crowdfunding Decentralized App
description:
This is a crowdfunding solution built entirely on web3: creators can host their projects for funding in crypto and withdraw the raised funds whenever they need to, without a traditional payment intermediary sitting in the middle.

The frontend is built with React.js and Vite.js, connecting to wallets through MetaMask and Ethers.js, with Hedera Hashgraph as the underlying distributed ledger. A Nest.js backend with Turso DB supports the off-chain side of the app.
